messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated 5xx/timeouts observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 since 12:02 UTC. Error rate ~8% and gateway timeouts increasing. Alert group: infra-kv, eng-runtime. Pager: @oncall_jordan :pager:
oncall_jordan: Picking this up. Looking at dashboards and traces now. Please call out customer impact if you have it.
sre_maya: Confirming spike. 502/504 and gateway timeouts correlating with KV prefix-cache miss rate spike (x10). p95 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s. Traces show repeated backend retries and fanout.
eng_runtime_lee: I see eviction churn on prefix shards 2/3/4, eviction queue length spiked on shard-3. Likely eviction storm causing thundering-miss to backing KV. Not safe to restart many hosts right now.
support_ravi: We have a support call from a paying customer reporting failures around 12:10. They see 5xx on every generation attempt. Do we have a status message? @cs_emma
cs_emma: Notified customers alpha/beta/gamma with a short note: "High error rates for inference in us-west-2, mitigation in progress; no data exposure." I'll post an update after first mitigation step.
sre_maya: Quick live mitigation proposal: flip routing for affected prefixes to bypass KV lookups (circuit-breaker) so requests do cold model runs instead of retrying KV backend, to stop backend overload. This will increase token cost/latency but reduce 5xx rate. I can flip via control-plane.
eng_runtime_lee: How do you flip that? Is there an API?
sre_maya: Yes — using the control-plane route toggle. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routes/flip \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"prefix":"user-prompt-v1","kv_lookup":false,"reason":"missstorm-live-mitigation"}'
```
oncall_jordan: Doing the flip now.
deploy-bot: Route update submitted by jordan@redwood (run-id: r-9876). 5 instances targeted, 2 failed to apply (control-plane timeout).
eng_runtime_lee: Failures look like hosts lost control-plane connectivity, probably due to the same network flakiness. I'll SSH into the two and push the change manually.
sre_maya: Also bumping gateway retry backoff to reduce fanout and enable 429 throttling for repeated KV timeouts. Patch rolling.
support_ravi: Customer-facing status update: "We are seeing elevated error rates for inference endpoints in us-west-2. Mitigation is in progress; engineers have applied a temporary routing change to reduce errors. ETA 30m for stabilization"
cs_emma: Sent update to customers. No billing notes yet.
eng_runtime_lee: Posting relevant logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:05:23Z] shard=shard-3 eviction_queue=842 miss_rate=0.72 backend_5xx=0.13
[2026-03-15T12:06:01Z] prefix=user-prompt-v1 cache_fetch_time=345ms timeout=1.2s
[2026-03-15T12:07:12Z] gateway request_id=ask_44k retries=4 upstream_504=true
```
sre_maya: After the routing flip completed on 3/5 hosts, error rate dropped from ~8% to ~1.2% and gateway timeouts decreased. Latency increased (p95 ~2.1s) as expected. Keeping circuit-breaker on for 1 hour while we stabilize.
eng_runtime_lee: Long-term followups: (1) increase TTL heuristics for hot prefixes, (2) smoother prefetch/backoff to avoid synchronized eviction, (3) review cache sizing on shard-3, (4) add more aggressive health checks for control-plane connectivity. I'll open RFCs and a follow-up ticket.
oncall_jordan: Oncall handoff: I'm going to stay on until 12:45 and then hand off to @sre_omar at 13:00 UTC. Handoff note: run-id r-9876, mitigation: route kv_lookup=false for prefix user-prompt-v1, monitor p95 and backend_5xx. If errors resurface, re-enable prefix prefetch smoothing and escalate to eng-runtime.
sre_omar: (acknowledged via mention) will take the 13:00 handoff.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate returned to baseline (~0.6%) at 12:42 UTC after full roll of route flip and gateway backoff. Customer-facing note updated. Postmortem scheduled on 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC.
-- RUNBOOK STEPS (left in thread for next oncall) --
1) Check dashboard: API /v1/generate 5xx rate and gateway timeout spikes.
2) Query KV metrics: prefix miss rate, eviction_queue, shard health.
3) If missstorm present -> flip prefix kv_lookup=false for affected prefixes via control-plane API.
4) If route updates fail on some hosts: ssh to host, run control-plane agent restart, apply config locally.
5) Apply gateway retry backoff patch to reduce fanout.
6) Notify support/CS and publish customer update.
7) Create follow-up tickets: TTL heuristics, prefetch smoothing, control-plane connectivity alerts.

(reacted :rotating_light: by oncall_jordan, :thumbsup: by cs_emma)
